def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:

    woman_patches = image_patch.find("woman")
    if not woman_patches: return image_patch
    
    phone_patches = image_patch.find("phone")
    if not phone_patches: return image_patch
    
    woman_phone_pairs = [(w, p) for w in woman_patches for p in phone_patches if is_between_3d(w, p, w)]
    
    if not woman_phone_pairs: return image_patch
    
    return woman_phone_pairs[0][0]
